UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's game progress and statistics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

currentLevel.description: The user's current level in the game.

bestLevel.description: The highest level the user has achieved.

lastPlayed.description: The timestamp of when the user last played.

stats.description: Aggregated statistics for the user's gameplay.

successRate.description: The user's puzzle success rate (0.0 to 1.0).

Landmark.title: Landmark
Landmark.description: Represents a curated puzzle landmark with metadata for difficulty and display.

name.description: The common name of the landmark.

country.description: The country where the landmark is located.

category.description: The visual category of the landmark image.

visualComplexity.description: A rating of the visual complexity of the image.

allowedGrids.description: An array of grid sizes (e.g., 3, 4, 5) that are appropriate for this landmark.

imageUrl.description: The URL to the curated image, hosted on a reliable CDN like Firebase Storage.

facts.description: An array of curated, interesting facts about the landmark.

definition.description: Stores user profiles and game progress. The 'userId' corresponds to the Firebase Auth UID.
Stores the curated list of all landmarks and their associated metadata for puzzles.
